name: upgrade-to-go-release
stderr:
pstack: pstack 0.29.0 is a Go binary released on GitHub, not an npm package — this command cannot install it.
Run the one-time hop instead (it reads this host's control/.env, so nothing rotates):

  curl -fsSL https://github.com/samishal1998/preview-stacks/releases/download/v0.29.0/install.sh | sh && pstack upgrade --resume

Rollback, if needed: docker tag pstack:local-previous pstack:local && docker compose -p pstack-control -f <PSTACK_DATA>/control/docker-compose.yml up -d
